integrity: The general equivalence is proved from the published Alexander-polynomial product formula and unique factorization in the Laurent polynomial ring. The finite verifier checks only orbit bookkeeping and the explicit 5_2 example; it is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the classical Fox--Milnor Alexander-polynomial obstruction for this construction. Passing the condition does not imply algebraic, topological, or smooth sliceness or ribbonness.
title: Fox–Milnor parity law for multiple-tangle extended symmetric unions
